item.title: Eastern DR Congo: the situation
item.description:
M23 rebels have seized a major town in eastern DRC, breaching a ceasefire and intensifying fighting with the Congolese army. ADF gunmen continue killing civilians in Ituri province amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak. Five European countries have agreed to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda, establishing a migrant return hub there. DR Congo and Rwanda are disputing leadership of the Francophonie, prompting a postponement of the vote. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
